popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book 1: Agamemnon's herald, sent with Talthybius to take Briseis from Achilles — the reluctant messenger of the quarrel that opens the poem.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: An Ithacan Eurybates attends Odysseus — round-shouldered, woolly-haired herald whom Odysseus honoured above the crew; ancient and modern readers often keep him beside the Achaean herald of the same name.

popCulture.title: Eurybates
popCulture.description: Homeric herald-name: Agamemnon's envoy for Briseis and Odysseus' trusted attendant.
